```{r}
library(ISLR)
```
```{r}
data("Carseats")
```

```{r}
Carseats=data.frame(Carseats)
```
```{r}
?carseats
```
```{r}
View(carseats)
```
```{r}
dim(Carseats)
```
```{r}
coef(Car_model)
```
```{r}
Car_model=lm(Sales~Price+US,data=Carseats)
summary(Car_model)
```
```{r}
Car_model=lm(Sales~Price+Urban+US,data=Carseats)
summary(Car_model)
```
